digest.heading: Monday email
digest.description: Last week’s bookings and seat fill, this week’s departures, and what is waiting on you. Sent Monday morning, {zone}.

afterHours.heading: After-hours messages
afterHours.description: An email when divers write in outside desk hours, {opens} to {closes} {zone}. One every half hour at most. A missed one can arrive within the hour.

howItWent.heading: How each departure went
howItWent.description: An email a few hours after each boat is due back, with a link to its head counts, what was sorted before boarding, and the waivers.
